pages.title: Start and Choose
pages.text: Begin a new life in Life Simulation. Its roots, methods, inventory, and cultivation belong to the simulated person.$(br2)Activities, journeys, and stories appear according to age, realm, history, and prerequisites. Some choices lead to battles. Read Planning the Year, Battles Within a Life, and Inheritance of a Life for their details.

pages.title: Manual Settlement
pages.text: While a simulation is active, Manual Settlement ends it early and settles its existing experiences and achievements. There is no need to wait for a long-lived cultivator to die.$(br2)Settlement ends this simulation; that same life cannot continue afterward.

pages.title: Claim an Inheritance
pages.text: After the simulation ends, inspect its inheritance rewards and choose one to claim. Only an actual claim applies the reward to your real character.$(br2)The same life cannot be claimed repeatedly, and opening settlement does not grant every displayed reward at once.
